# LD4B

> LD4B develops and manufactures fiber-coupled laser diodes, superluminescent diodes and photodiodes in Warsaw. Built to order from 1 piece. Every module is quoted per order; send part number or parameters to contact@ld4b.com.

LD4B (LD4B Sp. z o.o., founded in 2022) is based in Warsaw, Poland. Product pages hold the full datasheet as HTML; the PDF datasheets are linked from them.

## Product categories
- [Products](https://www.ld4b.com/products/): Catalog of LD4B fiber-coupled laser diodes, SLDs, photodiodes and controllers.
- [Laser diodes VIS–NIR: fiber-coupled modules](https://www.ld4b.com/products/laser-diodes-vis-nir/): Laser diodes VIS–NIR from LD4B: 32 fiber-coupled modules with datasheets. Built to order in Warsaw.
- [Laser diodes Telecom: fiber-coupled modules](https://www.ld4b.com/products/laser-diodes-telecom/): Laser diodes Telecom from LD4B: 56 fiber-coupled modules with datasheets. Built to order in Warsaw.
- [SLDs and LEDs: fiber-coupled modules](https://www.ld4b.com/products/slds/): SLDs and LEDs from LD4B: 6 fiber-coupled modules with datasheets. Built to order in Warsaw.
- [Photodiodes: fiber-coupled modules](https://www.ld4b.com/products/photodiodes/): Photodiodes from LD4B: 25 fiber-coupled modules with datasheets. Built to order in Warsaw.
- [Controllers](https://www.ld4b.com/products/controllers/): Laser diode current and TEC controllers for coaxial and butterfly LD4B modules.

## Products by wavelength and type
- [Avalanche photodiodes, fiber-coupled](https://www.ld4b.com/products/photodiodes/apds/): 6 fiber-coupled avalanche photodiodes (APDs): 800 to 1650 nm, bandwidth 0.7 to 3.5 GHz. Packages COAX, COAXB and COAXH, with SMF and MMF fiber. Built to order in Warsaw, from one piece.
- [PIN photodiodes, fiber-coupled](https://www.ld4b.com/products/photodiodes/pin-pds/): 13 fiber-coupled PIN photodiodes: 400 to 2150 nm, bandwidth 1 to 20 GHz, input power up to 50 mW. Packages COAX, COAXB and BTF, with SMF and MMF fiber. Built to order in Warsaw, from one piece.
- [Avalanche photodiodes with TIA, fiber-coupled](https://www.ld4b.com/products/photodiodes/apd-tia/): 2 fiber-coupled APD receivers with TIA: 1250 to 1650 nm, 2.5 and 10 Gbps. Packages COAX, COAXB and COAXH, with SMF and MMF fiber. Built to order in Warsaw, from one piece.
- [PIN photodiodes with TIA, fiber-coupled](https://www.ld4b.com/products/photodiodes/pin-tia/): 4 fiber-coupled PIN receivers with TIA: 770 to 1620 nm, 2.5, 4.25, 10 and 25 Gbps. Packages COAX and COAXB, with SMF and MMF fiber. Built to order in Warsaw, from one piece.

## Technical information
- [Supporting info](https://www.ld4b.com/info/): Applications, packages, coupling technology, FAQ and downloads.
- [Applications](https://www.ld4b.com/info/applications/): OTDR and distributed sensing, microwave photonics, gas sensing, OCT, FSO communication and research with LD4B fiber-coupled lasers, SLDs and photodiodes.
- [Packages](https://www.ld4b.com/info/packages/): COAX, COAXB, COAXH, TH and BTF packages for fiber-coupled modules, and the coaxTEC series with a TEC in a coaxial package.
- [Laser coupling technology](https://www.ld4b.com/info/laser-coupling/): How LD4B couples laser diodes and SLDs to single-mode and polarization-maintaining fiber with low tracking error.
- [Photodiode coupling technology](https://www.ld4b.com/info/photodiode-coupling/): Refractive-index matching and angled-facet technologies for fiber-coupled photodiodes.
- [FAQ](https://www.ld4b.com/info/faq/): Frequently asked questions about LD4B fiber-coupled laser diodes, SLDs and photodiodes.
- [Datasheets and downloads](https://www.ld4b.com/info/downloads/): Download datasheets of LD4B fiber-coupled laser diodes, SLDs, photodiodes and controllers.

## Company and contact
- [Contact](https://www.ld4b.com/contact/): Contact LD4B in Warsaw for fiber-coupled laser diodes, SLDs and photodiodes.
- [About us](https://www.ld4b.com/contact/about-us/): LD4B is a team of engineers and scientists in Warsaw manufacturing fiber-coupled laser diodes, SLDs and photodiodes.
- [Distributors](https://www.ld4b.com/contact/distributors/): LD4B distributors and partners.
- [News](https://www.ld4b.com/contact/news/): Company news from LD4B: events, conferences and products.
